property_summary: For any non-empty recipient list, transfer always returns true regardless of whether the low-level transferFrom calls succeed or fail.
For any non-empty recipient list with matching value array length, transfer returns true.
For any non-empty recipient list with matching value array length, transfer returns true even if the low-level transferFrom calls fail or succeed.
For any non-empty recipient list with matching value array length, transfer returns true.
For any non-empty recipient list with matching value array length, transfer always returns true regardless of whether the inner calls succeed.
For any transfer call with matching nonempty arrays, C always returns true and never reverts.
When transfer is called with a single-element address and value array, it does not revert and returns true.
compiler_error: a state-changing call on c is not a plain top-level statement, or c is reached through a low-level call / abi.encodeWithSignature / address cast / interface / helper. Every call must be `c.f(args);`, `x = c.f(args);`, or `try c.f(args) { ... } catch { ... }` at top level of the single public function; only view calls may sit inside require/assert

property_summary: For any call to transfer with non-empty address and value arrays of equal length, the function returns true and does not revert, regardless of the target addresses and values.
For any transfer call with exactly one element in the address array and the value array, C returns true and does not revert.
For a transfer call with a single-element array and a zero value, C returns true and does not revert.
For any non-empty list of transfer targets and amounts, the public transfer function returns true and makes a call to caddress for each target with the exact transferFrom selector and arguments.
